description: PVP-3D: 3D Point Cloud Dataset for Structural Health Monitoring of Photovoltaic Poles is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Mahdi Shamisavi, Isaac Segovia Ramírez (Universidad Autónoma de Madrid). The PVP-3D dataset contains 3D point clouds of support piles used in photovoltaic (PV) panel installations, acquired using aerial LiDAR sensing technology in real-world environments. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
